high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a news article with a yellow-highlighted section at the top labeled "STORY HIGHLIGHTS." The text within this section provides details about a wildfire that has been burning for five days. According to officials, the fire started when a man allegedly pushed a flaming car into a gully. The fire is located in a remote area approximately 180 miles (289.68 km) northeast of San Francisco. Below the highlighted section, there is additional text that describes the wildfire as the Park Fire, which is a massive wildfire in northern California.
